messages:
Javier: main CI red right after merge of PR #4828 (optimize-kernel). GPU smoke `gpu-smoke/kv-cache` failing on 2/3 shards. Details in CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4828

ci-bot: Build 4828 (merge) — smoke-gpu/kv-cache failed on runner gpu-a-03. Failure summary:
```
E runtime: CUDA assertion in kv_cache.cpp: index out of range
Test: kv_cache_eviction_test
```

Maya: @Javier can you paste the failing test tail and the commit hash?

Javier: commit a1b2c3d merged ~5m ago by @Patrick. Pasted tail:
```
kv_cache_eviction_test FAILED
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/gpu/test_kv_cache.py", line 134, in test_eviction
    assert cache.size() <= max_entries
AssertionError: 1024 > 512
```

Linh: grabbing this :eyes: I'll rerun the failing job and snapshot node. If it reproduces I'll bisect between master~3..master

Ravi: pinging @Patrick — did the kernel params change in that PR? If so maybe new kernel uses different padding.

Patrick: yes I increased prefetch window in kernel_dispatch from 8 -> 16 to reduce stalls. I thought it was safe but didn't run full gpu-smoke.

Linh: rerun started: `ci retry 2965432101 --job=gpu-smoke/kv-cache`

ci-bot: Rerun queued on gpu-a-03

Linh: rerun failed again, same assertion on gpu-a-03. Attaching node snapshot:
```
GPU: A100-SXM4
Driver: 525.89
Free mem: 2.1GB
Top process: python (kv_worker)
```

Maya: hmm could be nondeterministic memory growth. Can we try a rerun on a different host? Maybe gpu-b-02

Linh: queued rerun on gpu-b-02 now

ci-bot: Rerun on gpu-b-02 completed -> PASSED

Javier: interesting — passes on b, fails on a. Suggests node/environment. Maybe a miner daemon or leftover cache.

Ravi: possible node driver/firmware mismatch. @infra-sre can you check driver/firmware drift on gpu-a-03? (cc @oncall)

Linh: meanwhile I'll start a git-bisect between parent~3..HEAD to see if it's introduced by the PR or flaky infra.

Patrick: if it's infra we should rollback the prefetch change in PR to be safe, or gate with canary. Open to revert if needed.

Maya: agree — if bisect shows no code regression, escalate to infra. If bisect points to commit a1b2c3d, we revert and open a smaller follow-up.

Linh: bisect initial result: first few commits clean, failure reproduces on a1b2c3d -> marking potential regressing commit. I'll run confirm-bisect to be sure.

ci-bot: Confirm-bisect queued

Linh: confirm-bisect also reproduced. Filing revert PR to unblock main: https://git.redwood.dev/revert/4829

Javier: thanks Linh. @release can you hold the next deploy until revert merges? :lock:

Ravi: noted. I'll message ops. Good triage team :thumbsup:

Patrick: sorry for the break, will follow up with unit tests for the kernel path.

Linh: keeping this thread updated as revert merges and CI stabilizes.
